propositions: rebar must declare s3 as an optional dependency with git-remote-s3>=0.3.2 in pyproject.toml following the existing optional-extra pattern
require_s3_helper() must verify both that the git-remote-s3 console script exists on PATH and that the installed distribution version is at least 0.3.2 using stdlib-only version parsing

require_s3_helper() must raise OptionalDependencyError with an actionable install hint when the script is absent, distribution metadata is missing, the version is too old, or the version string is unparseable
the s3 EXTRAS probe in _optional.py must enable guard_import() to detect the git_remote_s3 importable package and emit the standard install message
_optional.py must remain stdlib-only with no dependencies on packaging or git_remote_s3 itself
unit tests must cover happy path (script present, version 0.3.2 or newer), script missing, metadata missing, version too old, version unparseable, and version suffixed cases
